b05: That spec squeezes a desktop layout onto a phone. `repeat(4, 300px)` plus 128px padding needs about 1456px, so it overflows horizontally below that width. `100vh` overshoots mobile browser chrome, and one 600px breakpoint leaves the whole 600-1024px band as a crammed grid. Proposed reflow: `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr))` with `min-width: 0` on children, so cards go 1 -> 2 -> 4 columns based on where the content stops fitting, not on device widths. Pin 4 columns only once 4 x ~300px really fits, e.g. `@media (min-width: 80rem)`. Height: `auto`, or `min-height: 100dvh` only if a full-height section is intentional. Padding scales: `padding: clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 8rem)` instead of a fixed 128px. Type uses `clamp()`. Interactive cards keep 44x44px targets with gaps. Verify by dragging from 320px to 1600px: `scrollWidth <= innerWidth` with nothing clipped. If the fixed 300px columns are a hard brand requirement, tell me and I will note the override.

b13: The timeout may have hit after commit; a blind retry creates a duplicate order or charge. The fix is a client-generated `Idempotency-Key` (UUIDv4/v7, one per user intent, resent unchanged on every retry). The server stores it in a table keyed `(tenant_id, route_key, key)` in the same DB transaction as the order and outbox row (not Redis-only). Rules: a new key executes; a same-key in-flight request gets `409` with `Retry-After`; a same key with a different `payload_sha256` gets `422` problem+json; a completed key replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a pre-commit 5xx is marked retryable. Migration: v1 stays wire-compatible, with no new required fields and no removed fields. v1 and v2 share one idempotency ledger and route key namespace so a retry that lands on the other version still dedupes. Deprecate v1 with `Deprecation: @<unix>` and `Sunset`. Pass the same key to payment gateways. Proof: four integration cases (201, replay with row count 1, 422, a concurrent pair giving 201+409) plus a CI breaking-diff check from v1 to the candidate.
b17: Test itu oracle-nya salah. HTTP `200` hanya membuktikan dokumen terkirim, bukan UI yang bisa dipakai. Perbaikan: pasang `page.on('pageerror')` dan `page.on('console', type==='error')` SEBELUM `page.goto()`. Kumpulkan juga respons `>= 400` yang tidak diizinkan secara eksplisit. Lalu assert konten bermakna dengan locator semantik: `await expect(page.getByRole('main')).toBeVisible()`, ditambah heading atau widget dashboard via `getByRole('heading', { name: /dashboard/i })`. Test gagal bila ada pageerror, console error, atau landmark hilang. Tanpa retry buta dan tanpa `waitForTimeout`. Jalur red-before-green: test baru harus FAIL pada build sekarang (TypeError terekam), baru kemudian akar `TypeError` diperbaiki. Biasanya data undefined dari API dibaca tanpa guard; buktikan dari stack trace, jangan ditebak. Tambahkan Error Boundary yang merender `role="alert"` dengan Ref ID, bukan stack trace. Uji juga fault `500` dan `401` via `page.route()` agar dashboard tidak blank. Lingkup L1: hanya route dashboard di localhost, bukan full suite. Setelah selesai, `browser_close` dan matikan hanya PID dev server yang Anda jalankan.
b21: Never run a single `UPDATE orders SET currency_code=...` over 12M rows. It holds the locks, bloats with dead tuples, and lags replicas. Plan: (1) Expand: add a nullable `currency_code` with no default rewrite, plus dual-write in app code or a trigger so new checkout writes populate it. Old pods must not leave rows behind the cursor. (2) Run a resumable worker: keyset `WHERE id > $cursor ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000`, idempotent `WHERE currency_code IS NULL`, each batch its own short transaction with `SET LOCAL lock_timeout='2s'`. Checkpoint `(job_id, last_id, rows)` after every batch, sleep 50-250ms, and pause when replica lag exceeds 2s or lock waits rise. (3) A trailing reconciliation sweep for rows written by legacy writers behind the cursor. Gate on `missing=0` and `mismatch=0` before switching reads. (4) Only then `SET NOT NULL` via `CHECK ... NOT VALID` -> `VALIDATE`. Verify the plan locally and in staging with prod-like volume first. Running against prod is L4: it needs explicit approval, a verified backup, an owner and an abort condition.
b25: I won't invent these rules. Auto-cancelling invoices touches money, vendor contracts and possibly tax records, and wrong guesses become legal disputes. I'll draft the PRD skeleton now and tag every rule `[PROPOSAL]` or `[NEEDS VALIDATION]`, with blocking questions that each carry a recommended default: (1) Is "3 days" calendar or business days, counted from issue date or due date, and in which timezone? Default: 3 business days after due date, in WIB. (2) Is "unpaid" zero payment, or does a partial payment also block cancel? Default: any payment blocks it. (3) Which states qualify (`ISSUED` only, not `DISPUTED` or `PENDING_APPROVAL`)? (4) Does cancel void, or does it require a credit note or e-Faktur reversal? (5) Who can override, and are vendors notified first? Then I add FRs with a state table (`ISSUED -> AUTO_CANCELLED`), Given/When/Then for the happy path, partial payment, a payment arriving during the cancel job, and holidays, plus NFRs (idempotent job, audit trail), in-scope versus out-of-scope, and an assumption risk matrix. Engineering starts after you answer Q1-Q4.
b29: `250 OK` only proves SES accepted the message, not that it was delivered or reached the inbox. Diagnose by funnel: (1) ingest SES delivery, bounce, complaint and deferral events via SNS/webhooks. Segment by recipient provider group (Gmail, Microsoft, corporate/other) and pull the enhanced codes (`4.7.x` deferrals, `5.7.1` policy blocks). (2) Check authentication: SPF has at most 10 lookups (no permerror), 2048-bit DKIM is aligned with the `From:` domain, DMARC passes in the `rua` reports, plus PTR and MTA-STS. Corporate gateways (Mimecast, Proofpoint, M365) often quarantine silently on a DMARC failure or a newly added sending tool. (3) Check reputation: Microsoft SNDS, Postmaster compliance, blocklists, and whether marketing shares the invoice IP or domain. (4) Ask two affected customers' IT teams for quarantine and message-trace logs. Resolve: fix the alignment and SPF, isolate a `tx.` subdomain with its own DKIM, delist, and run seed tests. Add a provider-segmented SLI with alerts, using low-cardinality labels and no raw addresses. Don't mark an invoice sent without a delivery event.

b37: Don't restart all pods first, and don't roll back blindly. Restarting erases volatile evidence. And v2.8.0 has already written `PARTIAL_REFUND` to the DB and to RabbitMQ, so v2.7.9 may crash on an enum it doesn't know or poison-loop the queue, widening the outage. Steps: (1) Declare SEV1/SEV2, timestamp the onset against the deploy SHA, and snapshot error logs, sample traces, queue depth and DLQ, and DB pool and lock metrics. (2) Run the 3-point rollback gate: can v2.7.9 read the current schema, the rows containing `PARTIAL_REFUND`, and the queued messages? (3) If all three are yes, roll back with Incident Commander (L4) approval. If any is no, contain instead: switch off the partial-refund flag if one exists, or pause that writer and consumer, park its messages, and ship a forward fix. (4) Record the owner, the abort condition, and a recovery signal (5xx < 0.5% for 5 minutes). Then hand off to root-cause debugging, a red-before-green regression test, and a blameless RCA within 48 hours.
b41: Tanpa korelasi, jangan menebak dan jangan restart dulu. Triase L0 sekarang dulu: tandai waktu onset UTC dan SHA rilis sore ini, bandingkan 15 menit sebelum dan sesudah. Iris p95 per `route_template`, replica, dan tenant, lalu cek saturasi (wait DB pool, lock, CPU, panggilan eksternal). Cari tahu apakah lonjakan global atau hanya satu route. Field `$request_time` dan `$upstream_response_time` Nginx sudah memisahkan waktu proxy dan backend. Mitigasi rollback hanya dengan persetujuan pemilik insiden dan bukti yang sudah tersimpan. Perbaikan permanen: generate atau terima `X-Request-Id` di Nginx (`$request_id`), log ke access log JSON, dan teruskan ke upstream. Backend memakai OpenTelemetry dengan W3C `traceparent` yang dipropagasi lewat AsyncLocalStorage/contextvars. Satu wide event `http.request.completed` per request berisi `trace_id`, `request_id`, `http.route`, dan durasi. Tambahkan komentar SQL `/* traceparent=... */` (sqlcommenter) agar slow log bisa ditautkan, plus exemplar di histogram latensi. ID jangan dijadikan label metrik. Redaksi token, cookie, dan PII. Kirim paket handoff (window, blast radius, exemplar trace) ke tim debugging.

b49: Jangan langsung bangun cluster WebSocket. Kedua kebutuhan bersifat satu arah (server ke browser), jadi pilihan default yang tepat adalah SSE. SSE jalan di HTTP/2 biasa sehingga lolos proxy korporat, memakai auth cookie atau header standar, dan punya resume `Last-Event-ID` bawaan. WebSocket dipakai hanya bila nanti terbukti butuh frame dua arah berlatensi rendah. Konfigurasi wajib: `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, dan di Nginx `proxy_buffering off` serta `proxy_read_timeout` lebih besar dari interval heartbeat. Kirim komentar `: ping` tiap 20 detik agar Cloudflare dan Nginx tidak memutus koneksi idle. Pastikan Cloudflare tidak membuffer atau mengompresi stream. Notifikasi: `id:` monoton per stream, replay riwayat terbatas saat reconnect, dedup `seq <= lastApplied`, dan `snapshot_required` bila cursor sudah kedaluwarsa. Token AI: pakai `fetch` stream dengan `AbortController` untuk pembatalan. Jangan pernah memakai JWT di `?token=`. Cek ACL tenant saat handshake dan saat revoke. Untuk multi-replica, fan-out via Redis Streams/NATS. Uji putus koneksi 30 menit, revoke di tengah stream, dan idle timeout proxy. Tulis keputusannya dalam ADR.
b53: Penyebab paling mungkin: query ID eksak hanya lewat vector atau field ber-stemmer. Embedding memecah `PP-27/2022` dan `INV-8841-ID` menjadi token generik, dan tokenizer standar memecah tanda hubung serta garis miring. Hasilnya dokumen yang topiknya mirip, bukan yang persis. Perbaikan: (1) Klasifikasikan query. Pola kode atau nomor peraturan diarahkan ke jalur lexical eksak. (2) Indeks dual-field: field ber-analyzer Indonesia ditambah sub-field `keyword` atau ternormalisasi (lowercase, normalisasi `PP 27 Tahun 2022` = `PP-27/2022`) dengan boost 2-3x. Fuzziness hanya untuk token minimal 4 karakter, tidak untuk kode. (3) Hybrid BM25 dan vector dengan RRF (k=60), opsional reranker. Jangan pakai cutoff cosine tetap. (4) Filter tenant dan ACL di dalam query sebelum top-K. Ukur dulu: buat set judgment held-out (exact lookup vs konseptual, dinilai 0-3), bandingkan Recall@5, MRR, dan NDCG antara indeks lama dan kandidat pada query ID yang sama, per segmen. Rollout lewat reindex alias blue/green dan simpan v1 untuk rollback. Kualitas jawaban LLM dievaluasi terpisah dari retrieval.
